title: Berkshire conservation designations in a retained MassGIS archive

sourceEditionStatement.meaning: Edition statement on the provider information page; not proof of this export's capture or transformation date.

latestObservedDesignationDate.meaning: Latest designation date observed among these records, not an archive edition or export date.

provider.name: MassGIS (Bureau of Geographic Information), Commonwealth of Massachusetts EOTSS
provider.originalStudyProviderCredit: MassGIS / Massachusetts Natural Heritage and Endangered Species Program

rights.qualification: Provider public-domain guidance and the absence of a separate archive-file statement are retained separately. No CC0 dedication is asserted.

archive.equalityEvidence: Retained S3 listing length and single-part ETag match local source length and MD5. The SHA-256 identifies the local retained bytes; a separate remote-body SHA-256 read is not claimed.

curated.assessmentQuestion: Which conservation designations and municipalities appear in this historical Berkshire archive?
curated.method: Group records by ACECID, require consistent NAME and DES_DATE, count municipal records, and collect distinct TOWN values. Do not sum designation-level area attributes.
curated.dataAcquisition: Reuse exact existing local bytes and retained S3/Catalog evidence; no new provider retrieval or hosted registration.
interpretationLimits: Historical planning inventory, not a statement of current regulatory status or official boundaries.
Municipalities come from existing TOWN attributes; no new spatial intersection is performed.
POLY_ACRES and ACEC_ACRES repeat designation-level areas across municipal records and must not be summed.
Unknown export/capture date and normalization method remain unknown.

existingOpenGeoReferences.meaning: Descriptive references to previously registered hosted records. These identifiers do not transfer ownership, credentials or access rights, and are not precreated identities for another installation.
